title: A Clock for the Lantern
author: Coral Okafor
blurb: Ansel Quintana, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
